theorem_title: The tight case: a cube-free set containing every odd residue
natural_language_statement:
Let $8 \mid N$ and let $A \subseteq \mathbb{Z}/N\mathbb{Z}$ be cube-free and contain every residue of odd value. Then $8|A| \le 5N$.

The extremal set contains all $N/2$ odd residues and meets this bound with equality.
source: Jason Long and Adam Zsolt Wagner, "The largest projective cube-free subsets of Z_{2^n}", arXiv:1810.01225, https://arxiv.org/abs/1810.01225; the all-odds bound stated here, for every modulus divisible by 8, is a step of this formalization rather than a numbered result of the paper
